sources.entry: Sure - Personal finance application for everyone (fork of Maybe). AGPL-3.0 Docker
Sure | Personal finance and wealth management app, a community fork of Maybe

summary.one_liner: Sure is a community-maintained fork of the abandoned Maybe Finance project: a self-hostable personal finance and wealth management app built with Ruby on Rails.
summary.what_it_does: Sure is a personal finance app that can be self-hosted with Docker and accessed from a browser, a macOS desktop app, a mobile app, API clients, and LLM agents. The README says it is a fully working app and describes it as a personal finance and wealth management tool. The repo includes developer setup steps for Rails, PostgreSQL and Redis, plus optional demo data with a sample login. A public dashboard tracks slow requests seen on the demo site, and the maintainers invite performance contributions. The README also covers the fork's history and trademark rules for the "Maybe" name.
use_cases: track personal budgets and net worth
personal finance app with AI assistant
manage finances from browser or mobile
contribute to an open-source finance app
notable: Community fork of the archived Maybe Finance app, with the fork's history and trademark rules explained in the README
Clients include browser, macOS desktop, mobile, API and LLM agent access
Optional demo data with a sample login
One-click Render deploy options, including AI-enabled variants
caveats: Developer setup needs Ruby, PostgreSQL >9.3 and Redis >5.4; the README points to separate Mac, Linux, Windows and dev-container guides
The README says data-heavy performance issues exist and are being worked on
One-click Render deploy depends on blueprint files kept in a separate repo, and the AI options need OpenAI or external assistant settings
